newsitem.title: USA: Prime Medical raises stake in two firms.
newsitem.headline: Prime Medical raises stake in two firms.

text.p: Prime Medical Services Inc said Thursday it raised its stake in San Diego Lithotripters LP and Indiana Lithotripters LP I.

It said it bought an additional 9.0 percent stake in San Diego Lithotripters, increasing its holding in the firm to 29 percent. It said it also raised its stake in Indiana Lithotripters by 5.90 percent to 27 percent.
It paid $800,000 for the additional stakes, it said.
Prime manages both partnerships, which serves nine hospitals in California and seven in Indiana, respectively.

The partnerships undertake lithotripsy, which is a non-invasive method for treating kidney stones. The method uses shock waves that pulverize kidney stones, permitting them to pass painlessly from the body.
Prime is the largest operator of lithotripters in the U.S., running 55 firms in 32 states.
